{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to completed orders
completed = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
completed['revenue_clean'] = completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Print the number of completed orders (to verify population)
print(f"Number of completed orders: {len(completed)}")

# Compute the mean revenue of completed orders (including QA)
mean_revenue_incl_qa = completed['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print the result
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders (including QA): {mean_revenue_incl_qa}")"}
